# Neural Link highlight_component never clears: the restore merges an object that lacks the highlight keys

## Context

Observed 2026-09-12 during a live Fleet Manager demo driven through the Neural Link: `highlight_component` (outline, 6 s) on the cockpit container, then box-shadow on a roster card and outline on the memories pane. Minutes later all three highlights were still painted — computed `outline: rgb(59,130,246) solid 2px`, `outline-offset: -2px` on the cockpit; `box-shadow: 0 0 10px #10b981, inset 0 0 10px #10b981` in the card's vnode style. The operator read the blue frame as a stuck focus outline. Writing the keys as `null` through `set_instance_properties({style: {outline: null, outlineOffset: null}})` cleared them at once — the fix's shape, measured before it was written.

## The Problem

`src/ai/client/ComponentService.mjs#highlightComponent` captures `originalStyle = component.style || {}`, applies `component.style = {...originalStyle, ...highlightStyle}`, and after `duration` restores with `component.style = originalStyle`. The restore object does not carry the highlight keys, and assigning it never removes them.

## The Architectural Reality

`Neo.component.Base` declares `style_` as a merge descriptor — `{[isDescriptor]: true, merge: 'shallow', value: null}` (`src/component/Base.mjs`, the `style_` config) — and its doc states the contract: *"to remove a style property you previously set, you MUST set it to `null`. Using `delete` or setting `undefined` will revert to the previous state"*. An object without a key keeps the key. `updateStyle()` then hands the merged object to the vdom root, and the vnode keeps `outline` / `boxShadow` for the life of the component. The highlight is the one `src/ai/client` caller that relies on key absence to undo a write.

## The Fix

In `highlightComponent`, restore by explicit value: snapshot the original values of exactly the keys the mode writes (`{...(component.style || {})}` read once, never the live object) and write them back, `null` where they were absent —
- outline mode: `{outline: original.outline ?? null, outlineOffset: original.outlineOffset ?? null}`
- box-shadow mode: `{boxShadow: original.boxShadow ?? null}`

Guard the timeout against a component destroyed meanwhile (`component.isDestroyed`). One unit arm per mode in the ai client's spec: after `duration` the component's style and the vnode root style carry no highlight key, a pre-existing `outline` value is restored, and the arms are red on the current code (the residue asserted first).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] After `duration`, `component.style` and the vnode root style carry no `outline` / `outlineOffset` (outline mode) and no `boxShadow` (box-shadow mode).
- [ ] A pre-existing value of a highlighted key is restored, not nulled.
- [ ] A component destroyed during the highlight does not throw on restore.
- [ ] Unit arms cover both modes; each is red before the fix.

## Out of Scope

The `style_` merge contract itself; the other `src/ai/client` services.
